citations.quote:
一辆载满货物的卡车就这么突然撞上了刚刚准备拐过路口的轿车。
玻璃碎片撒满了现场，轿车车身也已变形。一个轮胎从卡车车厢内蹦了出来。
[dialog]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4155_talr_1#5$1")]
[name="卢奇诺"]……救、救人……对，救人！
[dialog]
[charslot(duration=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral")]
[delay(time=2.5)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4155_talr_1#8$1")]
[name="卢奇诺"]该死，现在大伙都去主街区那边看竞演了……
[name="卢奇诺"]喂，车里面的人坚持住，我来想办法救你们出来——
[dialog]
[charslot(slot = "m",posfrom = "0,0", posto = "0,-50",duration=1)]
[delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4155_talr_1#5$1")]
[name="卢奇诺"]呃，这些是什么……轮胎里面还有其他东西？
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_walkfast")]
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#5$1",duration = 0.5)]
[delay(time=1)]
[name="卡彭"]在这，甘比诺，真是我们盯的那辆车！
[dialog]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#1$1",duration = 0.5)]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#4$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]明明只是喝口咖啡的工夫，怎么……这下全他妈完了！
[name="甘比诺"]本来只分到个打掩护的活儿就已经够倒霉了。苦劳全是我们，功劳一点捞不上……
[name="甘比诺"]现在这批货还在我们眼皮子底下出了问题——
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="卡彭"]恐怕更糟，你看看被撞的那辆轿车，是不是很眼熟？
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]这时候你还关心他妈的谁被撞了——
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]等等，那是，莱昂图索的……
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]……
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#8$1",focus="l")]
[name="卡彭"]……
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]我现在得承认之前你说回龙门的打算不算糟了。
[name="甘比诺"]趁警察和老板还没来得及反应，赶紧走，我们之间的账可以回龙门之后再慢慢算。
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="卡彭"]好不容易在这有点盼头，现在绝对不能认怂，别忘了我们来新沃尔西尼投奔威尼斯载具公司的原因是啥！
[name="卡彭"]没有西西里夫人，没有灰厅，甚至没有其他家族的掣肘。
[name="卡彭"]说不定，我们能在这混出个自己的家族来，甘比诺。
[name="卡彭"]看到街对面那个抱着盒子的小子了吗？现在这条路就他一个人看到了车祸，会不会他也不小心看到了卡车里藏的其他货？
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]……我懂你的意思了，他有没有真看到的确是我们说了算。你真是个坏种，卡彭。
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="卡彭"]只是找条活路罢了，顺便在老板面前立个功。
[name="卡彭"]走吧，把他带回去，说我们把现场唯一的目击者控制住了。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#6$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]……这些货？
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="卡彭"]是接货人需要考虑的事。别忘了，老板再三强调，我们只是打掩护的。
[name="卡彭"]至于莱昂图索……哼，愿他无恙。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#4$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]得快，不能让那小子被其他人给抢先带走了。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral", volume=0.7)]
[charslot(slot = "r",posfrom = "0,0", posto = "400,0",duration = 1.5)]
[delay(time=0.3)]
[charslot(slot = "l",posfrom = "0,0", posto = "400,0",duration = 1.5)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot]
[delay(time=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4155_talr_1#1$1")]
[name="卢奇诺"]嗯，还有人来帮忙？！
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4155_talr_1#1$1")]
[name="卢奇诺"]在这，车里还有人——
[dialog]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4155_talr_1#5$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=90, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$fightgeneral", volume=0.7)]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot ="m", afrom = 1, ato = 0,duration = 0.5,posfrom = "0,0", posto = "0,-60")]
[PlaySound(key="$bodyfalldown1")]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#1$1",duration=0.5)]
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1",duration=0.5)]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="卡彭"]晕死了。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]我来扛他。
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="卡彭"]这小子手里的那个箱子……
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]一起拿走，别留下任何线索。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_542_1#6$1",focus="r")]
[name="甘比诺"]你确定我们躲开监控了？
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_541_1#5$1",focus="l")]
[name="卡彭"]废话，我来这儿的第一件事就是摸清周围状况。
[name="卡彭"]走。

contributions.description: 卡彭在车祸现场掳走卢奇诺。
